verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms LangGraph nodes are flexible custom functions and tools can be freely defined/handled without relying on built-in ToolNode/LangChain tools, and MCPAdapter shows typed tool integration patterns, but there's no direct evidence of a concise, few-line typed-tool-defining API (e.g., decorator-based) or code examples demonstrating brevity — community notes even highlight the framework's abstraction overhead and lack of a default Node class.
